newsletter_description: Break your fast with authentic Afghan cuisine this Ramadan!
description: Went to Khorasan Kebab for Ramadan iftar, and overall it was a solid experience. The decor was nice, and I really liked their sit-down area (even though we couldn’t sit there this time 😅). For iftar, they provided dates, pakoras, salad, and rooh afza to break the fast — which was a nice touch. The salad was fresh and well seasoned, definitely appreciated after a long fast. For starters, we ordered bolani and mantu. The bolani was fresh and crispy on the outside and tasted really good. The mantu, personally, wasn’t my favorite. For mains, we got the Sultani combo kabab platter, lamb chops, Sultani chicken kebab platter, and a lamb wrap. Everything tasted great, but my clear favorites were the lamb chops along with the filet mignon — super flavorful and cooked just right. We also tried the lamb shank, which had a very original flavor and a smooth, tender texture. Overall, a good halal spot for iftar with variety and solid mains.

event_name: We Are the Work: Collective Power in Black Creativity

In celebration of Black History Month, this talk centers collective power as both a creative force and a pathway toward cultural preservation.
performer: Grei T. Booker, Daniel Jenkins, Kim Hill, Jordan Horton

event_name: "La Voz del Anonimato / The Voice of Anonymity" Exhibition
newsletter_description: Don't miss the final days of our Newark exhibitions!
description: “La voz del Anonimato / The Voice of Anonymity” presents artwork centering the voices of contemporary Andean diaspora members from the tri-state area. With this body of work, Layqa is focusing on historical invisibility, embodied by his study of unidentified colonial master painters of the Andes, and contemporary invisibility, experienced by immigrant people the world over, but specifically those living in the USA during the current rise of neo-fascism.

event_name: TRAP x TRAP: Bronx meets Queens
newsletter_description: Witness graffiti legends unite as TRAP TFA and TRAP IF share the same frame!
description: A moment decades in the making, where two distinct graffiti writers, TRAP TFA (Bronx) and TRAP IF (Queens), who shared the same name, are finally in the same frame, on the same wall, acknowledging their separate journeys and shared passion for graffiti culture. A conversation about their histories, the confusion surrounding their identities, and their lifelong dedication to the art form will be released soon.

newsletter_description: Start your weekend strong with Warm Power Vinyasa at ZURA!
description:
Teaching yoga was so hard when I first started doing it. Just like anything, it gets easier with practice. Now I teach power vinyasa, chair yoga, senior yoga, yoga for eating disorders, Pilates and Inside Flow… I still get nervous. But it’s exciting to lead the people in the room every single time.

Thankful for ZURA, Bloomfield Rec, Cornerstone Day School and all the other organizations that allow me to teach for them!

Catch my classes this weekend at ZURA!
Friday, 9:30 am Warm Power Vinyasa
Saturday, 9 am Hot Power Vinyasa
Sunday, 10 am, Warm Pilates 

Let’s get strong, long and calm together.
